title: 第17章 姜沫第18章 学神附体
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第17章姜沫（..）周望首先闻到的是一阵香味。
其实从科学的角度来说，再好看的女人也是不存在体香这种玩意儿的，什么“处子幽香”
，真闻到了也是心理作用。
但每个女人的确都会有自己独特的味道，它是混合了香水、护肤品、化妆品、沐浴露、洗发露等等之后形成的香气。
这种香味是有差别的。
有的会让你闻着很高级，而有的只会让你觉得刺鼻。
再往里扒一扒，它其实也象征着一个女人的品味，如何搭配出独属于自己的味道也是一门学问。
要从这个角度去说，称之为“体香”
也没什么毛病，因为大家都不一样嘛！
眼前这個女人的香味，是那种淡淡的松木气息，又混合着一点点类似于红酒的香气，还挺好闻的。
如果说苏雅婧身上的香味是那种百花绽放的明媚，那这个女人就是藏于深谷的雪松，只是闻气味都给人一种遥远的距离感，却又忍不住想顺着这幽香跋山涉水，一探到底。
周望微微抬头，就看清了女人的面容。
这一刹那，有了些心理铺垫的周望眼中还是闪过一丝惊艳。
原来她不止香味高级，脸也长得很高级。
二十几岁的年纪，妆容虽淡却处处透着精致，标准的禁欲系五官，盘起的头发将身上那股清冷范儿凸显得更加淋漓尽致。
“是她？”
等看到对方身上的白衬衫和黑色半身裙后，周望意识到这就是之前站在台阶上的那个女生。
原来不是妹妹，而是姐姐啊！
这逆天的颜值至少可以打到九十分，难怪回头率这么高了……
在周望打量对方的时候，女人已经把手缩了回来，蹙眉问道：“你故意的么？”

周望反应了一下才想明白对方说的是什么，他淡淡的笑道，“难道不是你占了我的便宜吗？”
“你……”
女人为之气结，但很快她的表情恢复了冷淡，“那可以麻烦你把手拿开么？”
“好的。”
周望果然收回了手，连带着将手中的书也一起抽走。
“这是我要找的书。”
“可是我先拿到了。”
周望扬了扬手，考虑到这是图书馆，没有继续跟对方争执，转身就走。
但女人却紧紧跟了上来，还轻声说道：“伱知不知道，你这样的招数很低级？”
周望诧异的看了一眼对方，这女人莫非以为自己是在和她搭讪吗？
好吧，只看脸的话，对方的确有误会的资本，但周望还是丝毫没给面子的嗤笑了一声。
即便周望什么都没说，但女人还是更生气了，她继续冷冷的说道，“难道不是么？”
“随你怎么想。”
周望自觉时间紧迫，他现在花在阅读上的每一分钟，都是在为自己的豪宅添砖加瓦，哪有心情跟这个女人掰扯？
就这么一会，阅览室里剩的位置已经不多了，他加快了脚步，好不容易才在一个靠后的阅览室里找到了一张空着的桌子。
坐下来之后，周望翻开了书打开了笔记本，正准备开始阅读，女人却紧随其后在周望对面拉开椅子坐了下来。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Wealth and Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 17 Jiang Mo (..) The first thing Zhou Wang smelled was a burst of fragrance.
In fact, from a scientific point of view, no matter how good-looking a woman is, there is no such thing as body fragrance. There is no such thing as a "virgin fragrance."
, it also has a psychological effect if you really smell it.
But every woman does have her own unique smell, which is the aroma formed after mixing perfume, skin care products, cosmetics, shower gel, shampoo, etc.
There is a difference in this scent.
Some will make you smell very high-end, while others will just make you feel pungent.
Taking a deeper look, it actually symbolizes a woman's taste. How to match it with her own unique taste is also a science.
To put it from this perspective, it’s called “body fragrance”
There is nothing wrong with it, because everyone is different!
The fragrance of the woman in front of me was a light pine wood smell, mixed with a little bit of red wine-like aroma, which was quite pleasant.
If the fragrance on Su Yajing's body is the bright fragrance of blooming flowers, then this woman is the cedar hidden in the deep valley. Just smelling it gives people a sense of distance, but they can't help but want to follow this fragrance and travel across mountains and rivers to find out.
Zhou Wang raised his head slightly and saw the woman's face clearly.
At this moment, Zhou Wang, who had some psychological preparation, still had a flash of surprise in his eyes.
It turns out that she not only has a high-end fragrance, but also has a high-end face.
In his twenties, his makeup is light but delicate, his facial features are standard ascetic, and his hair is tied up to highlight his cool style.
"Is it her?"
After seeing the white shirt and black skirt on the other party, Zhou Wang realized that this was the girl standing on the steps before.
It turns out that she is not a younger sister, but an older sister!
This incredible appearance can be rated at least 90%. No wonder the rate of turning heads is so high...
When Zhou Wang was sizing him up, the woman had already retracted her hand, frowned and asked, "Did you do this on purpose?"
Zhou Wang reacted for a moment before he figured out what the other party was talking about. He smiled faintly and said, "Didn't you take advantage of me?"
"You..."
The woman was furious, but her expression soon returned to coldness, "Can you please take your hands away?"
"Okay."
As expected, Zhou Wang withdrew his hand and took the book away with him.
"This is the book I'm looking for."
"But I got it first."
Zhou Wang raised his hand, and considering that this was a library, he did not continue to argue with the other party and turned around to leave.
But the woman followed closely and said softly: "Do you know that your tricks are very low-level?"
Zhou Wang glanced at the other party in surprise. Did this woman think he was chatting with her?
Well, if you just look at the face, the other party does have the capital to misunderstand, but Zhou Wang still sneered without giving any face.
Even though Zhou Wang didn't say anything, the woman still became angrier. She continued to say coldly, "Isn't it?"
"Whatever you think."
Zhou Wang feels that he is pressed for time. Every minute he spends reading now is adding bricks and tiles to his mansion. How can he be in the mood to break up with this woman?
After a while, there were not many seats left in the reading room. He quickened his pace and finally found an empty table in a reading room at the back.
After sitting down, Zhou Wang opened the book and notebook, and was about to start reading when the woman pulled up a chair opposite Zhou Wang and sat down.
